people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “ ‘ “But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches, and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.
translations.bsb: But you, O mountains of Israel, will produce branches and bear fruit for My people Israel, for they will soon come home.
translations.kjv: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.
